verdict.summary: Round 4 resolves the prior major finding: the exact comparison path delegates to `cmp_plain_decimal`, whose shared lexical splitter trims surrounding whitespace before validating and comparing, while derived-integer facet checks use that same normalized comparison. Consequently whitespace-padded derived-integer boundaries and out-of-i128 integer/decimal values are no longer rejected for the reason identified in round 3. The implementation preserves fail-closed handling for malformed, facet-invalid, non-numeric, NaN, and unsupported mixed exact/float cases; validates range restriction even for numerically unsatisfiable bodies; and drops such bodies only during lowering. The added validation and closure tests exercise the real path with positive, negative, boundary, arbitrary-precision, and control cases. No hostile instruction is present in the diff.
